title: On some arithmetic conditions of recurrent sequences modulo prime p
summary: We study the $K$-Fibonacci sequence $\mathcal{F}_p$ modulo prime $p$. Cardinalities of sets $|\mathcal{F}_p+\mathcal{F}_p|$ and $|\mathcal{F}_p\cdot\mathcal{F}_p|$ are estimated. We present the method of estimating doubling constant of some $m$-dimensional recurrent sets in $\mathbb{F}_p$.
